title: Tractor with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- rear wheel -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='70' r='20' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='70' r='20' fill='none' stroke='#8a6a3a' stroke-width='3'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='70' r='12' fill='#c8a24a'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='70' r='4' fill='#7a5a2a'/>
  <!-- front wheel -->
  <circle cx='76' cy='76' r='12' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='76' r='12' fill='none' stroke='#8a6a3a' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='76' r='6' fill='#c8a24a'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='76' r='2.5' fill='#7a5a2a'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <rect x='12' y='40' width='60' height='28' rx='5' fill='#d94b2b'/>
  <rect x='12' y='40' width='60' height='8' rx='4' fill='#f06a45'/>
  <!-- grille -->
  <rect x='14' y='34' width='18' height='16' rx='3' fill='#e8e0c8'/>
  <rect x='17' y='37' width='12' height='3' rx='1' fill='#9a9278'/>
  <rect x='17' y='43' width='12' height='3' rx='1' fill='#9a9278'/>
  <!-- exhaust -->
  <rect x='40' y='22' width='6' height='18' rx='2' fill='#8a8a9a'/>
  <rect x='39' y='18' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#b0b0c0'/>
  <!-- cab roof -->
  <rect x='44' y='30' width='26' height='12' rx='4' fill='#c8a24a'/>
  <!-- window -->
  <rect x='48' y='44' width='18' height='16' rx='3' fill='#7fd4e8'/>
  <rect x='48' y='44' width='18' height='4' rx='2' fill='#b8ecf6'/>
  <!-- smiley face on body -->
  <circle cx='60' cy='52' r='2.5' fill='#2a1a10'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='52' r='2.5' fill='#2a1a10'/>
  <path d='M60 58 Q64 63 68 58' stroke='#2a1a10' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- fender over rear wheel -->
  <path d='M14 62 Q18 46 34 46 Q50 46 54 62' fill='#f06a45' stroke='#d94b2b' stroke-width='2'/>
</svg>
